title: content/terrain.yaml — terrain TYPE catalog (base materials + cost/passable/§5 attributes, D4/D10)
description: The single owner of the terrain TYPE vocabulary (docs/design.md §5: 바탕재료 sand/soil/river/mountain/sea + 속성 벡터). Each entry is a `navmap.TerrainType` (base_cost / passable / required_tags) PLUS the §5 attribute preset (grain_size/moisture/temperature/depth/slope/salinity) that feeds the `terrain.<attr>` §6 operands (flora suitability, traversal gates, climate transitions). It is a TYPE table, NOT a layout — the per-run terrain LAYOUT (which cell is which type) is the world-gen / scenario fixture (docs/world-gen.md). platform/config compiles this into the navmap `types` table + the world's TerrainID→attrs join; EVERY terrain id referenced elsewhere (climate transitions from/to, objects.yaml source.depleted_terrain, resource affinity) MUST exist here (load-time validated, D10). Values are UNTUNED placeholders (adjustable later).

terrains.description: The terrain type catalog. Ids must be unique (platform/config enforces beyond JSON-Schema). At least the base materials + any `depleted_terrain` referenced by an ore node.

id.description: terrain type id (a base material like sand/soil/river/mountain/sea, or a derived type like bare_rock)

base_cost.description: navmap.TerrainType.BaseCost — multiplies step length (≥ 1; rough terrain > 1). High (not impassable) for swimmable water = traversable-at-cost (fauna R2).

passable.description: navmap.TerrainType.Passable — false ⇒ NEVER traversable (deep sea, cliff). NOTE (fauna R2): fauna treats high-base_cost water as traversable-at-cost via the world's footprint-only TerrainSampler; `passable:false` is for terrain that is truly impassable to everyone.

required_tags.description: navmap.TerrainType.RequiredTags — capability/action tags needed to ENTER a cell of this type (e.g. Swim for a ford, Climb for a steep slope); empty ⇒ none. Pathfinding only enters if the traversing action carries one of these.

attrs.description: The §5 attribute preset vector (docs/design.md §5). Feeds the `terrain.<attr>` §6 operands (flora suitability, traversal gates like `terrain.depth`↔Swim, climate transition conditions). A preset = base-material defaults; per-run overrides (e.g. climate raising `moisture`) are dynamic state, NOT here. All keys optional (absent ⇒ 0/neutral).

moisture.description: dry↔wet↔submerged base level; climate drives the dynamic value on top. [0,1].

temperature.description: STATIC terrain heat offset in °C (e.g. sun-baked rock); the DYNAMIC temperature is climate's (CA3). Default 0 (neutral).

depth.description: water depth (river mid, sea high; gates Swim via `terrain.depth`). [0,1] convention.

slope.description: incline (mountain high; gates Climb / raises cost). [0,1] convention.

extract.description: Terrain-driven `Mine` yield (resources R1 / WI-P3): the yield table a Mine over a cell of THIS terrain rolls when there is NO ore_node present — abundant materials (stone anywhere, clay on soil) come from the ground itself, no finite node. Reuses the §6(Dexterity, tool quality) yield mechanism (Xm5 / flora-yield). ABSENT ⇒ this terrain yields nothing to terrain-driven Mine (the scarce metals come from finite `ore_node` objects on mountain instead, objects.yaml `source`). Abundant ⇒ NO depletion in P1 (stone 고갈≈0); finite extraction is the ore_node path (the node-path SetTerrain reroute is unrelated to this).

extractYield.description: One terrain-driven Mine yield row (resources R1; parity with objects.yaml flora/Mine yieldEntry). `chance` is a §6 Formula → [0,1] success for a SEEDED roll (typically §6 over the actor's Dexterity + held tool quality, D7 — capability composition, not a skill); `qty` is the base [min,max] on success.

item.description: the produced item_kind id (objects.yaml; e.g. stone, clay)

chance.description: §6 Formula success probability (compiled by platform/config via expr; unknown operand = load failure, D10).

qty.description: [min,max] inclusive base quantity (0 ≤ min ≤ max, cross-checked by platform/config).
